source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor will change status when module is removed or inserted
Check SEL will have corresponding logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All STATUS_PSU1~6 should get pass result.

original_test_intent: Validate removal/insertion status and SEL for PSU1 through PSU6, but the criteria instead evaluate temperature thresholds and thermal protection.
original_method: An engineer services each PSU while IPMI status and SEL are captured.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer performs each PSU removal/insertion and physical verification; the agent collects supporting telemetry.
required_inputs: Supported service state and load limit
safety_requirements: Confirm remaining PSUs and feeds carry the load before each action.
Do not replace this scope with reboot cycles.
Stop on imbalance, derating or host instability; no retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, capture per-slot presence, input/output, sharing, SEL and host health around each engineer action.
Do not operate power hardware or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct criteria, approve and perform service sequence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly makes physical action manual; its read-only evidence remains supportive only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented per-slot status/power/SEL telemetry around the approved service SOP.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1~6, removal/insertion, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Align criteria, then service one PSU at a time under load limits and record presence, sharing, SEL, host continuity and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds feed/sharing acceptance and removes thermal-copy criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves all six slots and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-slot/feed removal can shut down the system.

project_override_considerations: Record fitted PSU count; a smaller topology cannot claim six-slot source coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure tests PSU presence/status while Criteria 1-4 test temperature threshold behavior; the same code is reused at row 1522 for unrelated reboot cycling.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The contradictory acceptance domain cannot be resolved by project parameters; physical service must wait for source correction.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Correct manual boundary but incomplete acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines feed/sharing evidence and rejects reboot substitution.

review_improvement: Makes each PSU slot and feed accountable for removal, continuity and restored load sharing.
independent_technical_reasoning: A presence transition is neither a temperature ramp nor a threshold event. Without status-specific criteria, all six physical actions would still lack a valid acceptance rule.
